title: When the World Shook Being an Account of the Great Adventure of Bastin, Bickley and Arbuthnot
sourceTitle:
When the World Shook

author: H. Rider (Henry Rider) Haggard
longDescription: Rider Haggard is a novel published in 1919. Three adventurers—Arbuthnot, Bickley, and Bastin—are shipwrecked on a South Sea island where they discover two figures in crystal coffins who have been unconscious for 250,000 years.

authorInfo.bio:
H. Rider (Henry Rider) Haggard (1856–1925) is the author of When the World Shook
Being an Account of the Great Adventure of Bastin, Bickley and Arbuthnot. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
